supported_domain.name: single-string-ordered-literal-batch-v1
supported_domain.records: Unique nonempty string IDs in the independent schedule order; repeated prompts retain distinct case outputs.
supported_domain.strings: One string input, output and reference per record; exact case-sensitive literal equality including leading whitespace, internal whitespace, punctuation, Unicode and empty strings, subject to the renderer restrictions below.
supported_domain.unsupported: Missing, duplicate, extra or reordered native rows; aggregate-only results; multiple targets, wrong metric configuration, native/source/score contradictions. Output-final LF is rejected because the pinned echo variable renderer removes one final newline. Output/reference values containing Nunjucks opening delimiters {{, {%, {# or file:// or package: are rejected before execution.
